# Referee cases: one per line, `name mode prec noprec grouping terminal...`.
# mode is `sentence` (whole input) or `prefix` (viable prefix); a verdict is
# `accept` (sentence), `viable` (prefix) or `refuse@N`, N the 1-based index of
# the token being read at the first error. grouping is referee-prec's (`-g`):
# `line:from-to` for each reduction of a rule carrying a precedence, its
# perly.y line and the half-open span of 0-based terminal indexes it covers
# (GRAMPROG is 0), comma-separated in reduction order up to the first error,
# or `-`. Terminals are perly.y's at 94e50866.

# Precedence evidence: `indirob: scalar %prec PREC_LOW` shifts `[` as a
# subscript, so `print $fh []` fails at `]` with precedence and is a viable
# prefix without it (`[]` read as the list); its neighbour `print $$fh[0]` is
# accepted by both.
print-fh-brackets prefix refuse@6 viable - GRAMPROG LSTOP PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD PERLY_BRACKET_OPEN PERLY_BRACKET_CLOSE
print-derefs-subscript sentence accept accept 1890:3-5,1634:6-7,1273:6-7,1262:6-7,1273:2-8,1788:2-8,1324:1-8,1273:1-8,1262:1-8 GRAMPROG LSTOP PERLY_DOLLAR PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD PERLY_BRACKET_OPEN THING PERLY_BRACKET_CLOSE PERLY_SEMICOLON

# `$a + $b + $c`: ambiguous without precedence, which the GLR build must not
# report as an error.
add-chain sentence accept accept 1582:1-3,1582:4-6,1430:1-6,1582:7-9,1430:1-9,1273:1-9,1262:1-9 GRAMPROG PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD ADDOP PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD ADDOP PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD PERLY_SEMICOLON

# `] ; $a ;`: bison recovers through `sideff: error` and yyparse returns 0, but
# it reported an error, so the sentence is refused.
error-recovered sentence refuse@2 refuse@2 - GRAMPROG PERLY_BRACKET_CLOSE PERLY_SEMICOLON PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD PERLY_SEMICOLON

# `catch_paren: empty` is omitted, as the port omits it: a catch without a
# variable is refused at its block, one with a variable is accepted.
catch-without-var sentence refuse@6 refuse@6 - GRAMPROG KW_TRY PERLY_BRACE_OPEN PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE KW_CATCH PERLY_BRACE_OPEN PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
catch-with-var sentence accept accept 815:5-9 GRAMPROG KW_TRY PERLY_BRACE_OPEN PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE KW_CATCH PERLY_PAREN_OPEN PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD PERLY_PAREN_CLOSE PERLY_BRACE_OPEN PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE

# A refusal kept from an action: the dangling comparison `$a < $b <`.
relop-dangling sentence refuse@8 refuse@8 1582:1-3,1582:4-6,1474:1-6 GRAMPROG PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD CHRELOP PERLY_DOLLAR BAREWORD CHRELOP PERLY_SEMICOLON
